name: URL_Normalizer
requirements: Default to HTTPS protocol if missing
Normalize hostname and protocol to lowercase
Remove default ports (80 for HTTP, 443 for HTTPS)
Remove common tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid, gclid, ref)
Sort query parameters alphabetically for consistency
Remove trailing slashes from paths (except for root)
edge_cases: Input strings that are not valid URLs even with a protocol prefix
Non-standard ports that should be preserved
Paths consisting only of a slash
Encoded characters in the path or query string
